gloss: year by year; with each passing year

definitions.gloss: year by year; with each passing year
definitions.explanation: Indicates a gradual change or progression that occurs as the years pass. Emphasizes cumulative or incremental change over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年|とし}ごとに⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Temperatures are rising year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{年|とし}ごとに⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧になっている。
examples.english: Your Japanese is getting better with each passing year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年|とし}ごとに⟦{減|へ}り→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The population of this town continues to decline year after year.

notes:
USAGE:
Follows the pattern ～ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (every ~), applied to ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (year). Used when describing trends, gradual changes, or recurring yearly events. Common in news reporting, statistics, and personal reflection.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧: year after year — more literary/formal, often used in written contexts
- ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧: every year — focuses on annual recurrence rather than gradual change
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: day by day — same pattern but with a shorter time scale
